# secureaccess_dlp_ai_guardrails_rule (Resource)

This resource manages a DLP AI Guardrails Rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_dlp_ai_guardrails_rule" "example" {
  name                                   = "my_dlp_ai_guardrails_rule"
  description                            = "My AI Guardrails rule"
  severity                               = "CRITICAL"
  enabled                                = true
  data_classification_scannable_contexts = ["CONTENT"]
  data_classifications = [
    {
      id   = "d309239a-b6fd-11ef-a825-0242ac120002"
      name = "Privacy Guardrail"
    }
  ]
  file_labels                  = ["Confidential"]
  file_size_configuration_type = "RANGE"
  file_size_from               = 1024
  file_size_from_unit          = "KB"
  file_size_to                 = 10240
  file_size_to_unit            = "KB"
  file_types_included = [
    {
      id   = 250
      name = "cdr"
    }
  ]
  file_type_groups_included = [
    {
      id   = 6
      name = "Documents"
    }
  ]
  file_types_excluded = [
    {
      id   = 156
      name = "dbf"
    }
  ]
  file_type_groups_excluded = [
    {
      id   = 2
      name = "Compressed files"
    }
  ]
  unclassified_files_scan = false
  identities_included = [
    {
      id      = 1442790899
      type_id = 7
    }
  ]
  identities_excluded = [
    {
      type_id = 40
    }
  ]
  action                         = "BLOCK"
  override_block                 = false
  notification_popup             = true
  email_notify_actor             = true
  email_notify_actors_manager    = true
  email_notify_custom_recipients = ["user1@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Action associated with the rule.
  - Choices: `BLOCK`, `MONITOR`
- `data_classification_scannable_contexts` (Set of String) Select where to search for the selected data classifications.
  - Choices: `CONTENT`, `FILENAME`
- `data_classifications` (Attributes Set) Classifications to scan using OR boolean logic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_classifications))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `identities_included` (Attributes Set) Identities included for scanning. Use `type_id` to specify whole types of identities (i.a. Network Tunnel Groups). Add `id` to specify individual identities within `type_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--identities_included))
- `name` (String) Name of the DLP AI Guardrails Rule.
- `severity` (String) Severity of the rule.
  - Choices: `CRITICAL`, `ALERT`, `WARNING`, `INFO`

### Optional

- `application_categories_included` (Attributes Set) Application categories included for scanning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--application_categories_included))
- `applications_included` (Attributes Set) Applications included for scanning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications_included))
- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `email_notification_template_id` (String) UUID of the notification template.
- `email_notify_actor` (Boolean) Sends email notifications to the actor.
- `email_notify_actors_manager` (Boolean) Sends email notifications to the actors' manager.
- `email_notify_custom_recipients` (Set of String) Sends email notifications to custom email addresses.
- `file_labels` (Set of String) Up to 10 labels that this rule will search for when inspecting document properties. Applicable only when `unclassified_files_scan` is not set to `true`.
- `file_size_configuration_type` (String) Configuration type for file size control. With `RANGE`, all `file_size_*` attributes are required. With `ALL`, none of them can be set.
  - Choices: `ALL`, `RANGE`
  - Default value: `ALL`
- `file_size_from` (Number) Minimum file size for file control. Required with `file_size_configuration_type` `RANGE`.
- `file_size_from_unit` (String) Unit of the minimum file size for file control. Required with `file_size_configuration_type` `RANGE`.
  - Choices: `KB`, `MB`
- `file_size_to` (Number) Maximum file size for file control. Required with `file_size_configuration_type` `RANGE`.
- `file_size_to_unit` (String) Unit of the maximum file size for file control. Required with `file_size_configuration_type` `RANGE`.
  - Choices: `KB`, `MB`
- `file_type_groups_excluded` (Attributes Set) File type groups excluded from file control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--file_type_groups_excluded))
- `file_type_groups_included` (Attributes Set) File type groups included for file control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--file_type_groups_included))
- `file_types_excluded` (Attributes Set) File types excluded from file control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--file_types_excluded))
- `file_types_included` (Attributes Set) File types included for file control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--file_types_included))
- `identities_excluded` (Attributes Set) Identities excluded from scanning. Use `type_id` to specify whole types of identities (i.a. Network Tunnel Groups). Add `id` to specify individual identities within `type_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--identities_excluded))
- `notification_popup` (Boolean) Sends endpoint notifications to the user's machine.
- `notification_template_id` (String) ID of the notification template for custom notifications.
- `override_block` (Boolean) Allow override with business justification. Requires `notification_popup` to be set to `true`.
  - Default value: `false`
- `unclassified_files_scan` (Boolean) Scan and log files with no labels. Applicable only when `file_labels` is unset.
  - Default value: `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_dlp_ai_guardrails_rule.example "<id>"
```
